entities.name: 2014 Algerian Air Force C-130 crash
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: On 11 February 2014, a C-130 Hercules military transport aircraft of the Algerian Air Force, carrying 74 passengers and 4 crew members, crashed into Djebel Fertas mountain near Aïn Kercha, Algeria. Only one person survived.
